remarks.para: This class is commonly used when accessing properties of a Data Object. The object reference is passed to the constructor.
The property objects can then be accessed with: GetPropertyNames(), GetPropertyType(), GetValue(), SetPropertyValue() and SetValue()
The typed property values can be retrieved with: GetDateTime(), GetDbDateString(), GetInt32() and GetString().

PropertyInfos.summary: Gets or sets the PropertyInfos value.

ParamConstructor.summary: Instantiates an instance of the class.

SetSource.summary: Sets the source object and type values.

GetPropertyNames.summary: Gets a list of the property names.

GetBoolean.summary: Gets the property value as a boolean.

GetByte.summary: Gets the property value as a byte.

GetBytes.summary: Gets the property value as a byte array.

GetChar.summary: Gets the property value as a char.

GetChars.summary: Gets the property value as a char array.

GetDateTime.summary: Gets the property value as a DateTime value.

GetDecimal.summary: Gets the property value as a decimal.

GetDouble.summary: Gets the property value as a double.

GetFloat.summary: Gets the property value as a float.

GetInt16.summary: Gets the property value as a short.

GetInt32.summary: Gets the property value as an integer.

GetInt64.summary: Gets the property value as a long.

GetString.summary: Gets the property value as a string.

GetValue.summary: Gets the property value as an object using a delegate. (E)

GetDbDateString.summary: Gets the property value as a DB date/time string.
GetDbDateString.returns: The object property value or null if not a valid date/time.

GetDbDateTime.summary: Gets the column object value as a DateTime.

GetValueReflect.summary: Gets the property value as an object using reflection.

SetPropertyValue.summary: Sets the property value based on value type. (E)
